b472_s1a.paragraph_now: One of the best side-effects of learning self-hypnosis is influence literacy: an increased awareness of all the ways your attention is being shaped in your day-to-day life. It could be a screen or a specific ad, a politician, religious fear, erotic imprinting, charismatic authority, the pressure to belong, shame, a sense of urgency, or just hearing the same thing over and over. It’s all around you. Sometimes it’s benign – like lullabies or prayers or being taught by a good teacher or listening to a beautiful song or being in love. But you may want to ask yourself what effect it’s having on your ability to see clearly and make choices.
b472_s1a.pair_now: Manipulation often comes with any of the following; urgency, you are special, FOMO (fear of missing out), not be included, sexual charge, shame, confused, someone will rescue you, destiny, you should obey, secret knowledge, and an excessive sense of certainty about something way too quickly and you have a sense that one good question will break the spell.

b472_s2a.paragraph_now: As you come back, undo anything you did to change your state on the way in. If you've floated, make sure you regain your weight (of your choice, of course). If you've shrunk, grow to your normal size again. If you've regressed or met parts, make sure you come back to feeling complete in the here and now and acknowledge that your body belongs to you and is under control of the adult mind. If you've gone somewhere, make sure you go back the same way. Etcetera. Make sure that the only things you bring out with you are the ones you want to.
b472_s2a.pair_now: To turn this off, stop rehearsing it, take it out of any recordings that you have, stop having it in any apps that are active, and go back to using your regular induction that you have been using. Say that you won't use it anymore when you are awake, but realize that just saying that it is gone won't make it go away immediately. If you are finding that you are responding to it when you don't want to, or you are having problems with being disoriented after using it, get some help from someone who is qualified to help you. If you want to keep it in, you can, but only for the use of starting a session at a later time when you want to. For now, today's trance will be over when you come out of it.

b472_s3a.what: Come all the way back P4 with P3 (the count) before it; part 9

edit.old: Move around a bit before getting up. Get up only when you feel steady. Make sure you're truly oriented and alert. Don't just assume it because you've done the count.
edit.new: Move around a bit before getting up, and only get up once you feel steady. Then check that you're really oriented and alert, because doing the count doesn't always bring you all the way back.

edits.old: Move around a bit before getting up. Get up only when you feel steady. Make sure you're truly oriented and alert. Don't just assume it because you've done the count.
edits.new: Move around a bit before getting up, and only get up once you feel steady. Then check that you're really oriented and alert, because doing the count doesn't always bring you all the way back.

b472_s3a.paragraph_now: When you come out, remind yourself what day (or date) it is. Look to your left and your right. Look at something near, and something far. Move around a bit before getting up, and only get up once you feel steady. Then check that you're really oriented and alert, because doing the count doesn't always bring you all the way back. Take mental note of anything that has come up for you and any actions you need to take regarding it. Then go on and do something normal.
b472_s3a.pair_now: Then count up, using these five steps: 1...feel your body again and what it's resting on, feel your weight (of your choice). 2...feel your breathing return to normal. 3...hear the room, name where you are. 4...wiggle your fingers and toes, move your shoulders and your eyes. 5...open your eyes, back in the here and now, feeling normal and clear. This session is now over.

Say that you won't use it anymore when you are awake, but realize that just saying that it is gone won't make it go away immediately. If you are finding that you are responding to it when you don't want to, or you are having problems with being disoriented after using it, get some help from someone who is qualified to help you. If you want to keep it in, you can, but only for the use of starting a session at a later time when you want to. For now, today's trance will be over when you come out of it.
edits.new: If you ever want to get rid of the shortcut, quit practicing it, take it out of your recordings and whatever apps you set it up in, and go back to your usual induction. Decide that while you're wide awake, and say it to yourself. Don't be surprised if it still works on you for a while, though. Saying it's gone doesn't erase it overnight. If it keeps kicking in when you don't want it to, or it leaves you spacey and disoriented after you use it, get help from someone qualified. And if you'd rather keep it, that's fine, as long as you only use it to start a session you've chosen for later. Either way, today's trance ends when you come back.

edits.old: Make sure to reverse anything you've done to alter your state when you come out of it. If you've floated, make sure you regain your weight (of your choice, of course). If you've shrunk, grow to your normal size again. If you've regressed or met parts, make sure you come back to feeling complete in the here and now and acknowledge that your body belongs to you and is under control of the adult mind. If you've gone somewhere, make sure you go back the same way. Etcetera. Make sure that the only things you bring out with you are the ones you want to.
edits.new: On the way out, undo whatever you did to get in. If you floated up like a balloon, come back down and feel your weight again (whatever weight you choose, of course). If you shrank, grow back to your normal size. If you were little again for a while, or spent time with your parts, come back to being all of you, here and now, in a body that's yours, with your adult self in the driver's seat. If you went somewhere, come back the way you came. Etcetera. The only things you bring back out are the ones you actually want.
